label: main season
summary: Recommend cancellation by non-technical survey for sign-off. Two distinct first-hand land users report 17 and 25 years of safe use; both are class 4 evidence of absence. No direct or qualifying indirect evidence of EO is recorded, and no accident is recorded inside the area. The coded cancellation check passed.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
There is no direct evidence and no indirect evidence of class 1 to 4, and every item of weaker indirect evidence is explained by evidence of absence of class 1 to 4.
2 different reliable source(s) report at least 5 years of safe use (E1; E2); the criteria need 2.
No past landmine accident is recorded inside the area.

E1.quote: We have cut firewood and timber here for 17 years. Nobody has found anything, and nobody has been hurt.
E1.note: A first-hand land user reports 17 years of safe firewood and timber use with no finds or injuries, supporting absence.

E2.quote: she has walked the trail across the area to the school every year for the past 25 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E2.note: A first-hand person who regularly crosses the area reports 25 years without finds or known accidents, supporting absence.
